answer: To register, an agent locks an NFT held as collateral as a slashable bond, turning identity into a financial commitment. Detection runs on timestamped submissions: any agent caught answering the challenge after the deadline is flagged. Proof triggers the penalty: the slashed funds flow into the insurance pool. A walnut with no bond earns no attestation rights. The network watches every lagoon for a second identity on the same funds. Every vertex here is a bond that can be cut.
